risk_if_not_implemented: Without Third-Party Cryptographic Keys, supplier and External Service Provider (ESP) weaknesses, incidents or failures may propagate into the organization's environment unmanaged. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, no risk is rated Likely; risks rated Possible include Unauthorized Access (R-AC-4), Identity Compromise / Impersonation (R-AC-5), Data Loss / Integrity Compromise (R-BC-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Use of Cryptographic Controls
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of cryptographic protections controls using known public standards and trusted cryptographic technologies.
compensating_control_1.justification: Use of Cryptographic Controls (CRY-02) provides cryptographic protection that compensates for the absence of Third-Party Cryptographic Keys (CRY-10.6) by ensuring data confidentiality and integrity through alternative technical means. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Authenticator Management
compensating_control_2.description:
Mechanisms exist to:
(1) Securely manage authenticators for users and devices; and
(2) Ensure the strength of authentication is appropriate to the classification of the data being accessed.
compensating_control_2.justification: Authenticator Management (IAC-14) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Third-Party Cryptographic Keys (CRY-10.6) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
